en: The image features a hand-colored postcard showing an ornate garden with a central fountain, elegant stone balustrades, and a large entrance gate flanked by statues. On the right, a prominent statue of a large bird (the Turul) stands atop a column. Several people are seen strolling in period attire, suggesting an early 20th-century setting. The text on the postcard includes 'Budapest.' and references to 'Várkert a Turullal' and 'Burggarten m. Turul.'
